newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia Jan skilled vacancies rise 2.1 pct.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia Jan skilled vacancies rise 2.1 pct.

text.p: The Australian government's index of skilled job vacancies rose 2.1 percent in January, the Employment Department said on Thursday.
The index rose to 149 in January, following declines in each month of 1996 except in December when the index was unchanged at 139, the department said in a statement.
The index was 11.3 percent below the index for the same month in 1996.
Increases were recorded in 11 of the 16 occupational groups, while the other five fell, the department said.

The largest increases were 8.5 percent for the building trades sector, 8.3 percent for other professionals including social workers, journalists and lawyers, and 7.2 percent for business professionals.
Medical and science technicians fell 4.6 percent, while health diagnosis and treatment practitioners dropped 3.4 percent, the department said.
The index was 125.8 percent above the recession low of 66 recorded in mid-1991.
The index measures skilled vacancy advertisements in the major city newspapers on the first Saturday of each month.
